description: This file defines React components related to a Drawer UI element, providing styled wrappers around primitive Drawer components and organizing them into a modular component structure.

methods.name: Drawer
methods.description: Main Drawer component that wraps the primitive Drawer root, allowing optional background scaling.

methods.name: DrawerOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with fixed positioning and semi-transparent background.

methods.name: DrawerContent
methods.description: Content container for the Drawer, includes overlay and styling.

methods.name: DrawerHeader
methods.description: Header section for the Drawer, styled with grid layout.

methods.name: DrawerFooter
methods.description: Footer section for the Drawer, styled with padding and gap.

methods.name: DrawerTitle
methods.description: Title element for the Drawer, styled heading.

methods.name: DrawerDescription
methods.description: Description element for the Drawer, styled paragraph.
